237:t_131:0.en:
$$刹那$$
(Why...? Why are memories of Mom... rising from deep inside me now...?)

237:t_131:1.en:
$$刹那$$
(Is this... their doing...? Are they... trying to rob me of my will to fight...?)

237:t_132:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(Damn it...! Feelings I thought I'd put behind me keep coming back! Is this their power, too?!)

237:t_133:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
(I... live after taking my own comrades' lives... Do I... have the right to live...?)

237:t_133:1.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(Quit babbling that crap...! What are you, a prisoner confessing his sins?!)

237:t_133:3.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(We've fought to survive! If you've got time for pointless regrets, fight!)

237:t_133:4.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(We don't have to hold back against assholes trying to peer into our hearts!!)

237:t_134:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(What is this feeling...? Something... fear is welling up from somewhere outside my own emotions...!)

237:t_134:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Fear of that fundamental calamity... Could it possibly be engraved in our genes...?!)

237:t_135:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
(The past I thought I'd shaken off... Once more it surges through my heart...!)

237:t_135:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
(Those things...! Are they spirits invading my heart...?!)

237:t_136:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Damn it... Damn it! Why can't I get these awful thoughts out of my head?!」

237:t_136:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Colonel! I'll fight with everything I've got to see you again!!」

237:t_136:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「So please! Give me just a little courage!!」

237:t_137:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
(I can tell... They're drawing out the fear and sorrow inside us, trying to make us submit to them...)

237:t_137:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
(...Someone is lending me strength... But who is it...?)

237:t_137:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
(It's gentle, vast, familiar... This powerful presence enveloping me is...)

237:t_138:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Ever since we entered this space, my $$スフィア$$ has been reacting to something...)

237:t_138:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
(What is this space? What is about to happen to the $$スフィア$$?)

237:t_139:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you're afraid, fall back. People who can't fight...」

237:t_139:4.en:
$n
「I'll overcome the fear inside me...! As I always have... and always will...!」

237:t_139:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
(As despair grows, so does hope... The $$いがみ合う双子$$ truly live up to their name...)

242:t_1:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「...I see. So you joined up with the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ at the galactic center...」

242:t_1:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「It sounds like you had your share of trouble, just like us.」

242:t_1:6.en:
$$渓$$
「You were transported together, so I get why you'd end up somewhere similar, but...」

242:t_1:7.en:
$$渓$$
「We were repairing the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ and $$真ゲッター$$ when it happened out of nowhere.」

242:t_1:8.en:
$$凱$$
「If we hadn't met $$グーラ$$ where we landed, we might have just kept drifting through space.」

242:t_1:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$グーラ$$... The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son...?」

242:t_1:10.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Yes. Apparently $$グーラ$$ had come to the galactic center to investigate $$ゲッター線$$ and $$バアル$$.」

242:t_1:11.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ isn't around to keep him in line anymore. After guiding $$號$$ and the others, he helped us fight $$バアル$$.」

242:t_1:12.en:
$$正太郎$$
「He left after the battle, though.」

242:t_1:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$グーラ$$ wasn't the only one we met again at the galactic center. While fighting $$宇宙怪獣$$, we ran into the $$ミケーネ神$$s again.」

242:t_1:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are they survivors of the ones we fought in the $$時獄戦役$$?」

242:t_1:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But meeting things like those again is hardly anything to be happy about.」

242:t_1:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Not necessarily. While fighting them, we got to see $$ゼウス$$ again.」

242:t_1:17.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The God of Light who lent us his power.」

242:t_1:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$ tried to send us back to Earth after the battle, but something interfered and it failed...」

242:t_1:19.en:
$$渓$$
「I don't suppose it was to make up for that, but we met my dad... Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$.」

242:t_1:21.en:
$$アルト$$
「He was possessed by the $$インベーダー#robot$$...」

242:t_1:22.en:
$$渓$$
「I don't understand how it worked, either, but Dad was free of the $$インベーダー#robot$$.」

242:t_1:23.en:
$$渓$$
「We met Dad in a mysterious space, with no idea where we were, and heard about the universe's collapse.」

242:t_1:26.en:
$$甲児$$
「According to the doctor, the universe collapses when the force that seeks to vanish clashes with the force that seeks to exist.」

242:t_1:27.en:
$$凱$$
「And the force that seeks to vanish creates $$バアル$$ to erase the life force of living things.」

242:t_1:28.en:
$$凱$$
「He also said that even if we survive the universe's collapse every 12,000 years, a true collapse comes every 120 million years.」

242:t_1:29.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's almost the same as what we heard in the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins...」

242:t_1:30.en:
$$凱$$
「...After that, thanks to the gracious guidance of our beloved $$ゲッター線$$, we were dumped into a fierce battle between $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$.」

242:t_1:31.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You sound a little bitter.」

242:t_1:32.en:
$$甲児$$
「Of course we do! I don't know what their reasons were, but they should try being the ones dragged all over the place!」

242:t_1:33.en:
$$渓$$
「With the $$インベーダー#robot$$ business, too, you really can't let your guard down around $$ゲッター線$$...」

242:t_1:34.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...Then, during that battle, we were caught in a $$時空震動$$ and transported to the same mysterious space you described.」

242:t_1:35.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So everything after that was pretty much the same.」

242:t_1:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, I never thought the fundamental calamity would be connected to $$サイデリアル$$...」

242:t_1:37.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... Those forces may be their trump card.」

242:t_1:38.en:
$$渓$$
「It's an enemy whose overwhelming power can even damage our hearts...」

242:t_1:39.en:
$$アルト$$
「The fear I felt when I saw it was different from anything I'd felt fighting other enemies.」

242:t_1:40.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Fear welling up from the depths of our hearts... It really is a fundamental enemy of humanity.」

242:t_1:41.en:
$$アルト$$
「But we'll fight... $n has overcome his fears and kept fighting all this time, too.」

242:t_1:42.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Speaking of which, where is $n...?」

242:t_1:43.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...He's still unconscious, even after we joined up. Probably because his bloodstained eyes appeared in that mysterious space.」

242:t_1:45.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$アルト$$... Isn't it about time $n woke up?」

242:t_1:46.en:
$$アルト$$
「We can't just leave him alone. Let's go see how he's doing.」

242:t_1:52.en:
$$ハサン$$
「He woke up quite some time ago.」

242:t_1:53.en:
$n
「What's up, you guys? You're all here together...」

242:t_1:54.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you talking about?! We came because we were worried about you!」

242:t_1:55.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's right! We heard you'd suddenly collapsed...!」

242:t_1:56.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Was it the bloodstained eyes after all?」
